text_en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
text_cn: 有上主论旱灾的话，传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Judah mourns and her gates languish; they lie in gloom on the ground, and the cry of Jerusalem goes up.
text_cn: 犹大悲哀，城门萧条，人人垂头至地，耶路撒冷哀号四起。

text_en: Her nobles send their servants for water; they come to the cisterns, they find no water, they return with their vessels empty. They are ashamed and dismayed and cover their heads,
text_cn: 显贵派童仆去打水，来到井旁，却不见有水，带着空器回去，迷惑惭愧，遮住自己的头。

text_en: because the ground is cracked. Because there has been no rain on the land the farmers are dismayed; they cover their heads.
text_cn: 因为地上不落雨，田地无法耕耘，农夫们都已绝望，遮住自己的头。

text_en: Even the doe in the field forsakes her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
text_cn: 甚至母鹿在田间生产，因为没有青草，也得抛弃自己的幼雏。

text_en: The wild asses stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail because there is no herbage.
text_cn: 野兽站在童山上，像野狗一般喘息；双目失神，因为没有草吃。

text_en: Although our iniquities testify against us, act, O Lord , for your name’s sake; our apostasies indeed are many, and we have sinned against you.
text_cn: 上主，我们的罪过若指证我们，但求你因你的名字而施救，因为我们屡次失节，得罪了你。

text_en: O hope of Israel, its savior in time of trouble, why should you be like a stranger in the land, like a traveler turning aside for the night?
text_cn: 你是以色列的希望，是她在患难中的救主。为什么你在本乡好像是个异乡人，好像是个投宿一夜的旅客？

text_en: Why should you be like someone confused, like a mighty warrior who cannot give help? Yet you, O Lord , are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; do not forsake us!
text_cn: 为什么你好像是个沉睡的人，好像是个不能施救的勇士？上主，你常在我们之中，我们是归你名下的人，求你不要离弃我们。

text_en: Thus says the Lord concerning this people: Truly they have loved to wander, they have not restrained their feet; therefore the Lord does not accept them, now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins.
text_cn: 上主论这人民这样说：“他们这样爱好游荡，没有约束自己的脚， 为此上主不喜悦他们；现在忆起了他们的过犯，就惩罚他们的罪恶。”

text_en: The Lord said to me: Do not pray for the welfare of this people.
text_cn: 上主对我说：“你不要为这人民求情！

text_en: Although they fast, I do not hear their cry, and although they offer burnt offering and grain offering, I do not accept them; but by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence I consume them.
text_cn: 即使他们斋戒，我也不会俯听他们的呼吁；即使他们奉献全燔祭和素祭，我也不会悦纳，反而要用战争、饥馑和瘟疫将他们消灭。”

text_en: Then I said: “Ah, Lord God ! Here are the prophets saying to them, ‘You shall not see the sword, nor shall you have famine, but I will give you true peace in this place. ’”
text_cn: 我于是说：“哎呀！我主上主！你看，先知们对他们说： 你们决不会见到战争，你们决不会遭受饥荒，在这地方我必赐给你们真正的平安。”

text_en: And the Lord said to me: The prophets are prophesying lies in my name; I did not send them, nor did I command them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a lying vision, worthless divination, and the deceit of their own minds.
text_cn: 上主对我说：“先知们以我的名预言谎话，我并没有派遣他们，也没有对他们说过话。他们给你们所预言的，是谎谬的幻象，空妄的卜筮(shì)，存心骗人的欺诈。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name though I did not send them, and who say, “Sword and famine shall not come on this land”: By sword and famine those prophets shall be consumed.
text_cn: 为此上主这样说：关于那些以我的名义说预言的先知，我既没有派遣他们，而他们反说：在这地方不会有战争和饥馑，他们就必死于战争和饥馑。

text_en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, victims of famine and sword. There shall be no one to bury them—themselves, their wives, their sons, and their daughters. For I will pour out their wickedness upon them.
text_cn: 至于听他们向自己讲说预言的人民，必因饥馑和战争，陈尸在耶路撒冷街头，没有人掩埋他们和他们的妻室子女；我必将他们的邪恶都倾注在他们身上。

text_en: You shall say to them this word: Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease, for the virgin daughter—my people—is struck down with a crushing blow, with a very grievous wound.
text_cn: 你应将这话转告他们：我眼泪直流，昼夜不息，因为我的处女──人民──大受摧残，受了严重的打击。

text_en: If I go out into the field, look—those killed by the sword! And if I enter the city, look—those sick with famine! For both prophet and priest ply their trade throughout the land, and have no knowledge.
text_cn: 我若走入田间，看见刀杀的遗尸；我若进入城里，看见饥馑的可怖惨状；就连先知和司祭们也流亡到他们素不相识的地方。”

text_en: Have you completely rejected Judah? Does your heart loathe Zion? Why have you struck us down so that there is no healing for us? We look for peace, but find no good; for a time of healing, but there is terror instead.
text_cn: 难道你决意抛弃犹大，实心厌恶熙雍？为什么你打击我们，致使我们医治无望？我们原是期待和平，却不见好转；希望医治的时日，却只见恐怖！

text_en: We acknowledge our wickedness, O Lord , the iniquity of our ancestors, for we have sinned against you.
text_cn: 上主，我们承认我们的罪恶，和我们祖先的过犯；我们实在得罪了你。

text_en: Do not spurn us, for your name’s sake; do not dishonor your glorious throne; remember and do not break your covenant with us.
text_cn: 愿你为了你的名，不要嫌弃，不要轻慢你光荣的御座！ 望你记忆，不要废除你与我们订立的盟约！

text_en: Can any idols of the nations bring rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Is it not you, O Lord our God? We set our hope on you, for it is you who do all this.
text_cn: 异民的“虚无”中，有能降雨的吗？或是诸天能自施甘霖？难道不只是你，上主我们的天主！我们寄望于你，因为你行了这一切事。
